summary.tldr: Draft 2 significantly shifts leverage to the Landlord: monthly rent increases from $2,200 to $2,500 ($300/mo increase), security deposit return deadline is doubled from 14 days to 30 days, and landlord inspection notice is reduced from 48 hours to 24 hours.

topChanges.title: Rent Increased by $300/mo ($2,200 → $2,500)
topChanges.explanation: Monthly rent increased from $2,200 to $2,500. Late fee increased from $50 to $75, and the grace period was eliminated.

topChanges.title: Security Deposit Return Delayed (14 days → 30 days)
topChanges.explanation: Deposit return timeframe lengthened from 14 days to 30 days post-moveout, holding your funds for twice as long.

topChanges.title: Landlord Inspection Notice Cut in Half (48h → 24h)
topChanges.explanation: Advance notice requirement for landlord access dropped from 48 hours to 24 hours, reducing your residential privacy.

summary.recommendation: Reject Draft 2 adjustments to Rent, Deposit, and Notice. Request maintaining Draft 1's $2,200 rate, 5-day grace period, 48-hour notice, and 14-day deposit refund.
